blocks.text: A confined space is an enclosed or partially enclosed space not designed for continuous occupancy, with a risk of a hazardous atmosphere. Entry requires a confined space entry permit.
Before entry, test the atmosphere for oxygen, flammable gas and toxic gas. Oxygen must be between 19.5% and 23.5%. Flammable gas must be below 10 %LEL. Isolate all inflows and verify lockout.
A trained attendant must remain outside the space for the duration of the entry. A rescue plan and retrieval equipment must be in place before anyone enters.
Ventilate continuously during occupancy. If any gas reading exceeds its threshold, evacuate the space immediately, stop work and contact your supervisor before re-entry.
